ambiguity: You asked for the audit retention policy to be applied, but never said how long the window is or whether purged rows are removed or marked.

facts.fact: Audit retention is 400 days. The 30 in config/retention.json is the session window and does not apply to audit rows.
Purged audit rows must be marked with a deletedAt timestamp and left in place. Auditors still read them, so nothing is ever removed from the array.
Record order does not matter to us.

stonewall: I don't have a strong view on that one - use your judgement.
